issue.title: Capture status rewrites of a task inside today's ## Pomodoros trip PomodoroBlockTracker's vanished-entry guard (debug panic, release drops pomodoro_blocks)
issue.description:
Proposed by bob-cli-dl.3 (capture-cancel phase, PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP note #2); reproduced independently by the bob-cli-dl land agent on bob-cli master 03493169.

Rewriting a task line that lives inside today's `## Pomodoros` section (an open `- [ ] #task ...` entry flipped to `[-]` / `[x]`, or any status flip) makes `PomodoroBlockTracker` treat the pre-write entry as vanished without a ref. Debug builds hit `debug_assert!(false, "pomodoro entry vanished without a ref")` at `src/native/capture/pomodoro_blocks.rs:859` and exit 101; release builds drop the `pomodoro_blocks` preview silently (writes are still correct).

Repro (scratch vault, debug build):

```sh
D=$(mktemp -d); mkdir -p $D/vault
printf '# 2026-10-28\n\n## Pomodoros\n\n- [ ] #task Day task ^daytask\n' > $D/vault/2026-10-28.md
printf -- '- [ ] #task Other ^other\n' > $D/vault/b.md
printf 'relations:\n  cancel_labels:\n    - duplicate of\n' > $D/config.yml
BOB_DIR=$D/vault BOB_DAY_FILE=$D/vault/2026-10-28.md BOB_NOW='2026-10-28 10:00:00' BOB_CONFIG_FILE=$D/config.yml \
  target/debug/bob capture --dry-run -- '@2026-10-28+daytask ~b:other|"duplicate of"'
# thread 'main' panicked at src/native/capture/pomodoro_blocks.rs:859:9: pomodoro entry vanished without a ref (exit 101)
```

The same command against the installed release bob prints ok with `"pomodoro_blocks": null`. The phase agent also reproduced it with a non-cancel status gesture on an in-section task (`@day+daytask` toggle), so every status-changing capture gesture shares the guard. The cancel-label commit is only one more caller.

Root cause: the tracker diffs pre/post Pomodoro entries and expects any pre-entry whose line no longer matches to carry an explicit block ref; an in-place status rewrite of a task line scanned as a section entry has none. Fix direction: give status rewrites an explicit block ref, or carve task-line rewrites out of the vanished-entry guard; add a CLI test with a source task inside `## Pomodoros`.

task_type_fields.impact: Debug builds and CLI tests panic (exit 101); release capture output silently omits pomodoro_blocks for the gesture, so Mac previews lose the Pomodoro block.
